notes: Clicked for credits turns 1-5 up to 25 credits without installing anything, then drew into a full grip and discarded on turns 12-14. Dirty Laundry into Wraparound on T11 with no breaker, and never contested the Server 9 remote while Corp scored Project Beale twice and Bellona (T12-T15).

Solid plan: scored GFI behind Resistor by T5 and closed with SanSan City Grid fast-advancing GFI on T14-15. Minor waste: early Hard-Hitting News on T3 with no follow-up and repeated Sensie Actors Union overdraws that forced discards.

Clicked for credits on T2-T15 up to 61 credits with no plan, then ran Archives about 30 times on T16-T22 seeing only Obokata Protocol and declining it each time. Never ran a remote while Corp scored Send a Message twice and Obokata Protocol.
Saw the Runner end T1 tagged with 2 cards in grip and immediately played Scorched Earth on T2 for the flatline; nothing to fault.

Good pressure: double Mining Accident on T2 starved the Corp, then Aumakua through Resistor let the Runner farm HQ for 7 points on T13-T15. Minor issues: ran into Resistor on T5 with almost no credits, and some low-value Archives runs.

On T3, Consulting Visit fetched Audacity to trash the whole HQ, dumping GFI and two Project Atlas into unprotected Archives, and the Runner stole all three the next turn. Also trashed Crowdfunding three times on T4, and the final Atlas in Server 1 on T8 was stolen through Hortum.

Facechecked Archer on R&D on T5 and lost Corroder, then was slow to find a decoder, so Corp scored to 6 points by T12 while the Runner clicked for credits on T8. Recovered well with Sneakdoor Beta HQ steals on T14-15 and a strong close (Gordian, Crypsis, Inside Job).

Spent almost every click from T2 to T16 gaining credits, reaching 67, and never installed a card. Made no runs on the remotes while Corp scored Efficiency Committee twice, Project Vitruvius and Accelerated Beta Test.

From T6 to T16, held Viktor 2.0, Eli 1.0, Tollbooth, Grim and Ice Wall with 20-45 credits and only clicked for credits (even playing Biotic Labor for credit clicks). Meanwhile the Runner ran HQ through Pop-up Window and R&D through Rototurret every turn and stole the winning agendas. Accelerated Beta Test also binned Gila Hands into unprotected Archives on T5.

Won against a Runner who never contested, but was very slow: clicked for credits and discarded on T2-T5 instead of installing agendas. Odd use of clicks advancing R&D ice, and Building Blocks put Border Control on Archives.

Hoarded over 120 credits by clicking for credits (T5-T13, T24-T27) and took 30 turns to score 7. Team Sponsorship put AR-Enhanced Security into a naked Server 1 on T16 (stolen), Quantum Predictive Model was discarded into open Archives (stolen T27), and repeated Hard-Hitting News tags were never punished.

Aggressive early runs on unrezzed R&D and HQ took Hostile Takeover on T1 and SDS Drone Deployment on T2 (giving up Black Orchestra to steal it), and Hippo on Border Control kept R&D open for the T9 win. The only waste was a full credit-click T3.

Left R&D unprotected until T4, and Project Beale was stolen from it on T2. Then clicked for credits and discarded every turn T2-T8 with a full HQ, and played Psychographics for nothing on T9, before scoring out of a one-ice remote that the Runner never contested.

Sensible R&D pressure on T1-T2 and a Dirty Laundry trash of Marilyn Campaign, but from T8 on only clicked for credits up to 34 credits. Never contested Server 6, even with Offworld Office sitting advanced behind one ice on T11, while Corp scored out.

Facechecked Resistor twice on T1 and Wraparound on T2 with no breakers, then used Self-modifying Code on T8 to fetch Cloak instead of a fracter while Corp scored GFI and Beale through Wraparound. Good mid-game recovery with Corroder and Temujin, but it came too late.

Clicked for credits T2-T7 and discarded instead of adding ice while the Runner stole Offworld Office and Atlas through Mausolus. Spent T9-T12 making repeated 2-credit trashes of Daily Casts and Aeneas Informant down to 0 credits, Economic Warfare did nothing on T8, and Audacity on T14 dumped GFI into open Archives to lose.

Coherent plan of self-tagging with Paparazzi/Joshua B. to fuel Data Leak Reversal, milling R&D into unprotected Archives for Beale, GFI and AstroScript. Early waste: Eater ran into Enigma on T1 and there was a breakerless facecheck of Resistor on T2.

Hansei Review binned Longevity Serum into unprotected Archives on T3 (stolen), and Divert Power on T6 had no clear target. Won when the Runner overextended into Loki after Obokata, rather than through Corp planning.
Efficient: IP Block remote held GFI and two Beales, and Breaking News was fast-advanced on T4. A few passive credit-click turns on T6-T8 with a heavily tagged Runner and nothing to punish it with.

Clicked for credits T4-T9 up to 42 credits while Corp scored Hostile Takeover and Atlas, never running the remotes. Dirty Laundry into unrezzed Archer on T10 lost Aumakua and the T12 run into Hortum failed, so Corp scored out unopposed.
